# Published GenomicX design tokens

Vendored unmodified from `@genomicx/ui@0.10.1` on npm. Tarball SHA-1: `dc06de5a6e1736f0a88f76ef2d29460eac7d9a05`. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@genomicx/ui/v/0.10.1

This plain static site has no build/install step. To refresh, run `npm pack @genomicx/ui@0.10.1` in a temporary directory, extract the archive, and copy `package/src/styles/tokens.css`, the complete `package/src/styles/fonts/` directory and `package/LICENSE` here. Update this provenance record and compare desktop/mobile layouts before publishing. Fonts retain their bundled SIL Open Font Licences.
